summary: The material and texture library. Phase 1 (the frozen API contract) published first and pushed, unblocking D, E, F and G. Phase 2 landed all 20 families on real albedo+normal+roughness, four shared detail-normal tiles, a twelve-band trim atlas, wear and wetness as masks rather than scalars, thirteen region palettes over one texture set, and a magenta-on-purpose fallback. The 96px hash-noise field is retired from every family. Every capture is SwiftShader and is therefore a builder diagnostic, not an appearance claim: the hardware Deck run is the critic's.

api_contract.note: Options may be added and never removed or repurposed. Four of the seven declared variant axes were live in the first commit; all seven are live now.

gates.coverage: 20/20 families authored, 19 texture sets, 281 MB high / 70 MB medium — PASS
gates.close_up: 15/20 families resolve structure at 0.5 m — GREEN (bar >= 15)
gates.close_up_null_control: mean shading 0.0798 authored vs 0.0061 on the noise fallback; 0/20 would pass on noise
gates.coverage_null_control: delete a normal map on a copy: gate FAILs and the family renders magenta as visual-family:<f>:ASSET-LOAD-FAILED while its neighbour is untouched
gates.wear: 4/5 subjects selective; chitin inverts and is named, not tuned away
gates.wetness: reads on 5/5, delta -10.3% to -22.1% between the wet and dry arms
gates.palette: 78 region pairs over one stone set, closest 0.013 hue / 0.011 value; control (same swatch twice) exactly 0.0000

not_done: KTX2/Basis compression — no basisu or toktx on this host; budget met without it, deferral and one-command reversal recorded in manifest.json
library census — W1-30V owns tools/visual/library-census.mjs and it does not exist yet; visualFoundationCensus() now reports the fields it will need
bounded live proof on the pod (3 streets, 2 vistas, 1 rain transition) — NOT RUN. All builder captures are SwiftShader, which W1-30-EVIDENCE.md forbids for appearance claims
diffuse-floor removal test, naive grouping test, M1-M12 tripwire, full Deck, texture memory on hardware — critic-owned per the plan's allocation
trim atlas has zero realised consumers today (E has no kit, D has no equipment); published and frozen so they need not wait, but one consumer short of W1-30-LIBRARY.md section 3
known_weaknesses: reed still reads washed-out in the close-up sheet and I would not defend it to a judge
leaf, reed, root and cloth clear the shading threshold but miss albedo contrast; water is a declared exemption
the chitin wear mask is pointed at the grooves rather than the plate rims; the fix belongs in the synth script's height field

outside_declared_paths.tools/render/w1-30-assets.mjs: It validated the old three-set manifest and the 256px generated atlas, both of which this piece removes, so it would have gone permanently red for everyone. Rewritten for manifest@2 rather than left broken. No other live piece declares it.

next_step: Dispatch the fresh W1-30C critic. The single test I most want run is the diffuse-floor removal on the eight settlement street shots on hardware: the floor at consumeStyleboard was compensating for missing texture detail and should now be removable. Second is the naive grouping test with reports/w1-30/C-closeup/family-closeup-full.jpg as the pack.
